values.note: RV campers $27 a day, based on 4 campers per unit (tent campers $17), as posted on the park's website, which was last updated in 2019. RV Life campers paid $25-30 a night in 2025-2026.

fees.source: https://cherokeerv.com/ ('Rates for Camping ... RV campers $27.00* ... * Price based upon 4 campers per unit'), read 2026-10-29

note: Older family-owned park in the woods ~5 mi from Helen. Mostly full-time and seasonal residents per 2025 RV Life reviews; nightly sites sold. Recreation hall, playground, picnic deck with a mountain view. Lake Burton a few miles off. --Claude
summary: Operator site (FrontPage, last updated 2019) confirms 38 wooded lots with 30/50 A, water, sewer, cable, WiFi; drive-through sites; open year-round; RV $27/day posted. Phone 706-878-2267 and pin (~80 m from Google) OK. Laundry and phone-booking (note-derived, page silent) cleared. Long-stay character noted (passes the five tests: posted nightly rate + phone, $27, no minimum). Note trimmed of counts/hookups/rate/booking.
flags: Stale operator page: cherokeerv.com was last modified 2019-02-05 (still advertises Oktoberfest 2019). Its $27 rate is kept as the page states it, but RV Life campers paid $25 (3/2026, 6/2025) and $30 (9/2025, 6/2025, 3/2025). Google Maps now lists facebook.com/northgacamping as the park's site; the human may prefer it in website alongside or instead of cherokeerv.com.

Long-stay character: RV Life reviewers write 'It was mostly full time residents that were there' (6/2025) and 'an older campground with mostly permanent or seasonal campers' (3/2025). It passes the five tests on what is published (posted $27 nightly rate + phone, no minimum, no lease/application, no site count split); the note now says so. A human decides.
Facilities: a 9/2025 reviewer says 'don't recommend the use any of the facilities'; the operator page lists no bathhouse or laundry.
